integrity: The all-parameter proof is a coordinatewise generating-function factorization. Finite exhaustive computation is used only as corroboration and not as a substitute for the proof.
limitations: The formula gives exact pairwise intersection from the full signed displacement vector; it does not reduce the answer to a scalar distance, improve asymptotic packing density by itself, or classify optimal codes.
title: Exact arbitrary-center intersections of limited-magnitude error balls
